name: Kami Kare
source:
The protagonist leaves the city to a shrine to help relatives.
But runs into handsome Gods there?!
And after listening to the Enshrined Deity who protects the region,
You end up having a xxx training under a divinity, guardian dogs and an enshrined deity!
translation:
主人公离开城市，前往神社帮助亲戚。

然而，他在那里遇见了英俊的神明们！？

在听取守护当地的神明、镇守犬与祭祀神明的教诲后，你最终要在神性存在下进行某种性爱训练！
